previous.changeLog:
Changes
Added compatibility fixes for World of Tanks 2.3.1.3
Updated native carousel patch support for the current Gameface bundle
Improved full-package build automation to detect the active client root automatically
Removed hardcoded 2.3.1.2 dependency assumptions
Improved dependency resolution for Gameface and ModsSettingsAPI
Bumped mod version metadata to 1.0.8

Technical details
The native carousel patch includes the new 2.3.1.3 bundle hash and the updated UI references used by the current game build.

previous.changeLog: Updated for World of Tanks 2.4. Fixed the game process sometimes staying open after you quit, especially on a fresh unlinked install. Overmatch now waits for you to click Link in the garage notification or mod settings instead of starting account linking automatically. Background checks and uploads no longer delay shutdown, and interrupted uploads retry the next time you play.

current.changeLog: Updated for World of Tanks 2.4. Fixed the game process sometimes staying open after you quit, especially on a fresh unlinked install. Overmatch now waits for you to click Link in the garage notification or mod settings instead of starting account linking automatically. Background checks and uploads no longer delay shutdown, and interrupted uploads retry the next time you play.

previous.changeLog:
— Fixed a bug where disabling one of the Mark of Excellence lists and then re-enabling it could leave a duplicate copy behind in the garage filter dropdown instead of replacing the old one.
— Fixed the garage filter jumping back to one of the dynamic lists right after a battle, even while "My Vehicles" or another list was selected. 
- Fixed a Mod Settings+ button-click bug that could crash other mods' settings tabs too. Assorted log-noise cleanup.
— "XP grind for TXI" is now its own Weekly priority tier — Weekly is four independently toggleable groups instead of three.
